definitions.short: by implication, an encampment or village
definitions.full: H2333. chavvah II. [ חַוָּה ] noun feminine tent-village — Plural חַֹוּתֵיהֶם Num 32:41 (JE), compare Di. Elsewhere in compound appellative, almost = proper name יָאִיר חַֹוּת Deut 3:14 ; Josh 13:30 (D), Judg 10:4 ; 1Kin 4:13 ; 1Chr 2:23 . — I. חַוָּה proper name, feminine see above
definitions.rootNote: properly, the same as 2332 ( life-giving , i.e. living-place );
